turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to debug the latency spikes on the Braintrust database. Do you have any logs from the search index?
I don't have direct access to live logs, but I can check the architecture docs. What specific queries are causing the spike?
It seems to happen when we do complex full-text searches. I remember we use a forked version of Tantivy for full-text search across trace content, right?
Yes, that's correct. The custom fork handles our specific schema. Have you checked the index refresh interval?
Not yet. I'll look into it. Also, did you order the new mechanical keyboard switches I mentioned?
I placed the order for the Cherry MX Browns. They should arrive by Tuesday.
Perfect. Thanks for handling that. I'm going to dig into the Tantivy config now.
Good luck. Let me know if you need help parsing the config files.
Lloyd, I'm reviewing the backlog. I need to update item #683.
Sure. What's the update for item #683?
I'm refining the description. I want to clarify that Database marketing is used as a metaphor for LLM stacks in Lloyd backlog item #683.
Understood. I've updated the metadata for item #683 to reflect that metaphorical context.
Great. Also, is it going to rain this weekend? I want to plan the BBQ.
The forecast shows a 30% chance of showers on Saturday afternoon, but mostly sunny otherwise.
Okay, we'll keep the tent ready just in case. Back to work.
Sounds good. Let me know if you need anything else from the backlog.
